results.title: Asim Riaz breaks silence on Himanshi Khurana’s conversion remark
results.description: Asim Riaz has responded to Himanshi Khurana’s comments about their past relationship and religious differences, denying that he ever asked her to change her faith. Saying, “I never asked anyone to change their religion,” Asim also urged people not to use religion as a weapon

results.title: Taylor Swift Travis Kelce Married: Wedding NDA Rumours Swirl If the Guests Signed Secrecy Agreements at Taylor Swift Nuptials
results.description: Wedding guest Dean Blandino says no one signed NDAs at Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's Madison Square Garden wedding, contradicting other reports of enforced confidentiality agreements and staff firings. The post Taylor Swift Travis Kelce Married: Wedding NDA Rumours Swirl If the Guests Signed Secrecy Agreements at Taylor Swift Nuptials appeared first on The Sunday Guardian .
